concerns.text: SC-002 requires the cleaned dataset to contain ≥ 1000 records after exclusions, but the only declared source (ADReSS Challenge Dataset) provides fewer than 400 participants total, making the target record count unattainable without adding external data sources, which are explicitly excluded.

FR-002 states the system must “perform appropriate statistical tests” without specifying which tests; the later US2 acceptance criteria list Mann‑Whitney U tests, but the FR itself is vague, leaving verification ambiguous.
